notes.title: Introducing: Player Hideout!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Explorers! 👋[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]We have a few last preparations to make before the launch of the public playtest, and we want to showcase some of the mechanics that will be included in the playtest version.[/p][p]This month, we were working on a player hideout/base, where you will be making upgrades for the elevator, crafting new tools, and preparing yourself for the next descent. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914763/61d64dd9c133f1eaf28ed57add23f082e332e909.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914763/945451f4476c5edcbf969be47c2a145d4b0744f2.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914763/6c2f1cff521fde2467d6f468efd64ba2d862847f.png"][/img][/p][p]We are also working on adding two new language supports: Thai and Turkish.

[b]See you soon,[/b][/p][p][b]Glitchless Games[/b][/p]

notes.title: FAQ #1
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Explorers! 👋[/h1]

[h2]Today we will answer your most common questions! 💬[/h2]

🎮 [b]What is the genre of this game?[/b]
Horror game with rogue-like elements, like permadeath, map generation, and between-runs progression.

⏳ [b]How long will the game be?[/b]
The game is extremely repayable as any other roguelike game, so a full game can take several hours to complete.

🌐 [b]Will it be multiplayer?[/b]
We have no plans for multiplayer, as it is rogue-like, the main focus is on the single-player experience.

🔄 [b]Will the game be updated after release?[/b]
Yes, the game is designed to be modular and easily expandable in the future.

 🐞 [b]Are you planning to run beta tests before release?[/b]
Yes, you can get a beta tester role in our [url=https://discord.gg/pNNJmzGw9Z]Discord[/url] and wait until the next beta test is announced so that anyone can participate in game testing.

Best regards,
Glitchless Games
